argument: The seven throats must read as cuts suspended in one architectural body before they read as seven interactive targets. Extrusion, front/back shell, asymmetrical silhouette, and the copper echoes must carry the image without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v043's contour quorum, v044's shutters, and v045's pressure slab. It should read as a singular spatial vessel with false resonance, not a 3D control panel or generic box sculpture.

The visitor must hold attention without moving, then release. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the deterministic listen control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only action may carry the work.

A moving hold, a short hold, and an unreleased hold must remain geometry-neutral. Only a motionless threshold-crossing release may alter actual throat position, depth, scale, rotation, and echo facet.
The attended throat must remain exactly unchanged while a different throat answers. If the work dents the contacted throat or merely draws a halo, the social-echo translation fails.

The work must make stillness an active condition, not a timer attached to a button. Movement must refuse the event, and the difference must survive in the state and geometry rather than only in status copy.
Four misheard echoes must compound in one vessel. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding geometry and release must return to the deterministic quiet vessel.
Generated p5.js WEBGL shell facets, depth-bearing throats, shadows, and echo planes are the medium. No screenshot, imported model, external font, or decorative particle system may carry the work.

little-critters is translated from situated proximity and reciprocal looking into stillness being misheard as a chorus. No animals, eyes, characters, paper scene, source palette, source composition, source code, example, or API surface is reproduced.

Delete v046 if movement or a short hold commits, the attended source changes, the echo is cosmetic, all echoes coincide, later memory resets, exact lifting fails, or the blind vessel is another planar field, wall, slab, contour orbit, or generic 3D demo.
